method: BASELINE. scope: From the seat of the ratepayer, for the WA lives (Chloe c055; Daniel d084): Part 6 Division 6 -- s 6.26(1)-(2) (rateable land); s 6.28 (gross rental value or unimproved value: the Minister's determination, the rural/non-rural principle answered conditionally; the 1 July valuation or a later interim valuation); ss 6.32(1)-(2), 6.35(1) (general rate in the dollar, minimum payment, specified area rate, service charge); s 6.33(3)-(4); s 6.36(3) (21 days); ss 6.39(2), 6.40(1), (3) (reassessment, refund or credit); s 6.41 (rate notice, email, deemed service, 28 days); ss 6.43, 6.44 (charge on land; joint and several); s 6.45 (single payment or 4 instalments; remaining instalments; instalment charge); s 6.46; s 6.50 (35 days; 2 months between instalments); s 6.51 (interest by resolution, prescribed maximum an input, simple daily interest assumed; none for a rebate or deferment entitlement); ss 6.52, 6.53, 6.55, 6.56, 6.60, 6.61 ($5,000), 6.62; ss 6.64(1), (3), 6.67(1), 6.69; ss 6.76, 6.77, 6.78, 6.80, 6.81, 6.82 (objections, 42 days; valuations under the Valuation of Land Act 1978). Pensioner and seniors rebates and deferments: pointer to the Rates and Charges (Rebates and Deferments) Act 1992, not encoded. Not encoded: Divisions 1-5, mining and petroleum land (ss 6.26(2A), 6.27, 6.29, 6.30), Schedule 6.1 phasing, ss 6.34, 6.35(2)-(6), 6.37-6.38 uses, sale and transfer procedure (ss 6.65-6.75, Schedules 6.2, 6.3).
